ev.q: Postlicensure data were reviewed from four observational studies of vaccine effectiveness
In a modeling study, estimated public health benefits of protein subunit RSV vaccination were compared
On June 26, 2024, ACIP voted to update these recommendations as follows
using the Evidence to Recommendation Framework (EtR) to guide its deliberations
Full details for Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluations (GRADE) are available

methods_quotes.q: Manufacturer-calculated efficacy based on hazard ratios.
Relative risk is pooled risk of events across phase 2/3 and phase 1 trials.
The analysis compared GBS incidence during a risk interval (days 1–42 postvaccination) with that during a control interval (days 43–90 postvaccination).
Ranges in estimated preventable disease incorporated uncertainty in incidence of RSV-associated outcomes and in vaccine effectiveness, using Monte Carlo simulation.
Self-controlled case series analysis estimated vaccine-attributable risk of three (95% CI = −3 to 10) GBS cases.
